element_fields.help_en: The remarks for the Cloud Firewall member account. The value must be 1 to 256 characters in length. You can add up to 20 member accounts

element_fields.help_en: The UID of the Cloud Firewall member account. You can add up to 20 member accounts
element_fields.help_zh: 云防火墙成员账号的UID。最多可添加20个成员账号
